metadata.title: Fix permissions for SSO admin and support admin revoke
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Closes #2331 
Closes #2386

---

## 📌 Summary
- Modified token generation in sso_service.py to omit teams key for admin users (matching email_auth.py behavior)
- Modified sso_service.py to support both promotion AND demotion

## 💡 Fix Description

Issue #2331: SSO admin role not revoked when user removed from IdP admin group                                        
                                                                                                                      
Root cause: Code only upgraded is_admin via SSO, never downgraded.                                                    
                                                                                                                      
Fix:                                                                                                                  
- Added admin_origin column to EmailUser model to track how admin status was granted                                  
- Modified sso_service.py to support both promotion AND demotion:                                                     
  - If should_be_admin is True and admin_origin is None or "sso" → grant and set origin to "sso"                      
  - If should_be_admin is False and admin_origin is "sso" → revoke and clear origin                                   
- Manual/API grants (origin=None, "manual", "api") are preserved and never auto-demoted                               
                                                                                                                      
Issue #2386: SSO admin tokens include teams key, preventing unrestricted admin bypass                                 
                                                                                                                      
Root cause: SSO token generation always included teams key, while email auth omitted it for admins.                   
                                                                                                                      
Fix:                                                                                                                  
- Modified token generation in sso_service.py to omit teams key for admin users (matching email_auth.py behavior)     
- Admin users now get no teams key, enabling unrestricted access bypass                                               
                                                                            

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          |    pass    |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          |    pass    |

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)
- [x] Matches current MCP spec
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
